shots.visual_event: Midnight. Twelve witnesses hold mirrors as Platform 13 physically unfolds from the tiled wall; the train arrives without headlights.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “Whatever steps off, keep saying its name.”

shots.visual_event: Door Four opens. Arin stands inside with Saira; Meera reaches for him, but Arin sends Saira first.
Saira crosses. Every witness repeats her name while the exchange plaque demands a replacement in warning red.
Arin plants his cracked badge in the door, temporarily satisfying the mechanism; the train tears away with him still aboard.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “Arin!” Arin: “Now you know how to call me.”

shots.visual_event: Saira sees a modern skyline for the first time. Her compass points toward a river—then every city light beyond it goes dark.
Dawn reveals a river separating two crowds who insist no bridge ever existed; only Meera, Maya, Saira, and Tick remember it.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “We brought back a person. The city lost a place.”

end_card.text: ARC I COMPLETE — THE CITY IS BEING ERASED
